data: Pros: Amazing gameplay and lots of fun challenges
Excellent fun with friends highly recommend
A really good game with a very good story
Very fun game, well worth the buy especially when on sale
Its a really fun game with lots of replayability
Don't waste your money on this buggy mess of a game
This game is boring, repetitive, and honestly greedy
ever since the latest update (definitive) the AI cheats to the point that the game is unplayable don't waste your money
unfortunately the gameplay doesn't work for me
The combat system is extremely shallow and repetitive

Game is cute and lovely and all but it lacks depth.

The Map is made by hexagon tiles which you need to scout. Once you scouted it, you can colonize it for food. Each additional tile cost more food. The tiles sometimes have special attributes, like you can hunt on it or build a farm. This makes the game kinda linear.

You also cycle through problems. As you grow you need more wood, more food, more gold and start again with more wood. It is nice however that this little economy has a realistic aspect: you need to grow a lot in workers in order to squeeze out more specialist, like an additional soldier.

But in the end it comes down to build and army and attack the enemy who doesn't present a real challenge. I got enough after 5 hours since everything is just repeating.

Great concept, very Settlers-esque. It's nicely paced, and environmental challenges add an extra dimension to a rare RTS.

The combat needs work, though. At the moment the pathing is horrible and targeting is janky, This makes it much harder than it needs to be to retain units, which is super important in a game where growing population is key.

The base building and exploring mechanics are fun and I'd recommend giving it a go. I hope that they improve the combat in later updates.

This game reminds me of the original World of Warcraft and Starcraft before they became online multiplayer games. I used to love those games and now I love Northgard! There are so many different ways to play the game between single player, multiplayer, story mode, and conquest which I have not tried yet. I highly recommend this game!

This game is AWESOME!
It is not a common strategy where you need to desolate the entire map and kill all the enemies- you can also be victorious by trading your resources and sell them to other clans, get famous among other clans or capture some places on the map such as a Hellgate(Helheim) or a Tree of Wisdom(Yggdraasil). At the beginning you chose your clan(there are 8 clans) and this will decide which winning strategy will you go for. This is a game for those players, who like games with much possibilities, hours of thinking which move to make and for those who just wants to be a GREAT VIKING!!
10 of 10, best strategy ever!!!

The strategic depth is both challenging and rewarding, offering a balance that keeps you engaged without overwhelming you. The diverse clans and their unique abilities add a layer of replayability so you won't get bored easy. Whether you're a fan of real-time strategy or new to the genre, Northgard is a must-play title that delivers an enjoyable and satisfying gaming experience.
I like this game a lot as a RTS fan and previously played C&C, SC2 and more... highly recommend it as it does not go too much into micro management which is not my style :)

This game gets boring quite quickyl. I plan to play more, but this is my initial short review.

Interesting graphs and beginnning of story feels nice. I extremely dislike the map segmentation system. It makes absolutely no sense that enemy is in different segment, but your tower doesn't shoot at it even it is close and you can run away from enemy. It's a mood killer for me.

I think that many people will like this game a lot, but it's not for me. At least not yet.
Really, really well-crafted RTS but the Story Mode (even on Normal, the lowest difficulty) punishes Turtle-style, and since Turtle-style is how I love to play RTS, this game sucks.

This is a fun game but don't expect any deep strategy.
The AI blatantly cheats with infinite resources and manpower which is a shame.

For you every lost man will hurt in resources and villagers.
The AI however keeps throwing warbands (which cost villagers and gold) at you at an impossible speed.
Why is this cheating? Well if you destroy half you opponents lands and do not encounter a single gold making building while the AI keeps throwing 5 man warbands at you including a leader. This is hundreds of gold each time.
Villagers spawn every 19 days or so in a happy clan yet the AI attacks me about 6 times a year while also replenishing shitloads of villagers I kill in his lands.

The AI will also keep conquering new lands straight and throw a lot of villagers and buildings which again cost a lot of resources.

This really kills the fun in the end because when you are fighting three opponents you normally have to fight smart.
But there are only few units and no other tactic than make the biggest warband you can and hope that you can destroy your opponent in one go. Otherwise the AI will undo in a matter of minutes the damage you caused.

have been playing this game for a long time and im really sad Shiro destroyed the game. Game is in 4 of 5 MP matches unplayable due to lags, sometimes never ending freezes and i can say, this was not happening some years back. Its nice when they add something new to the game, but when u cant even play it, then its a pain. Im still trying to play it, but its hard to enjoy the game like i did before. DO SOMETHING WITH IT SHIRO ,PLEASE! i would recommend the game if there is no problem with it, but at this time if u want to play MP. dont buy!

At the beginning of my experience of the game, I thought it was complicated and you should think well and read. But when I finished the beginning of the first stage in the story, it became very easy and I understood how to play, build and distribute soldiers.

I liked the gameplay strategy, the distribution of soldiers, the attack, and the functions of the characters within the game

I like it, I really do, but the AI CHEATS. You CANNOT beat the AI in a straight fight, and they ALWAYS have all the resources they need to replenish losses.

If they can improve the AI to hide this better, I would definitely recommend.

A wonderful game with a bunch of new mechanics introduced into the world of strategic games. It does not bore you or overexcite you but balances the fun and competition in the campaign. Personally I had loads of fun in the last 16 hours of continuous play and learnt new things and ideas. I will be coming back for more now and then just to refresh my memory of the game.

A must-play and a sight for sore eyes for strategy-game lovers like AOE, Red Alert, Civilizations, Starcraft etc.

Boring, time sink, and clunky. So many mechanics are there just to waste your time. It is like the Dev team got together and pondered on the most obnoxious mechanics they can put into a city builder. Your game can be cursed before you even start, just by having mobs spawn next to you. . . .

I'm sad about this one. It's a reasonably fun game, a streamlined RTS with some unique mechanics. Unfortunately, the multiplayer seems to have some real issues. Tried playing matches with my friends but the server stopped responding both times after playing long enough to feel like you got cheated out of your playtime. I also was concerned about the potential longevity of the game, as I didn't think it'd really hold up after a few hours.

Combine both of those issues, and I decided a refund was the choice to make. Maybe someday I'll return, but not today.
Very simple yet extremely enjoyable RTS. Love the gameplay, the graphics, and it has a very very good soundtrack

These downward spirals are ridiculous in this game. And the game mechanic doesn't allow for chill gameplay. You're constantly under pressure to build mandatory buildings. And in time. When you then get constantly attacked (in storymode) in 3 zones, far away from the zone where you want to progress, you're just running around and repairing non stop.
Nah, thanks. If you're looking for a chill City Builder with combat elements, I would recommend looking elsewhere.
The Conquests and Campaign are a nice fun little challenge for a bit if you're trying to get away from multiplayer games for a bit.

Love that it is not turned based. Don't get me wrong, I like Civ a smuch as the next gamer, but it's good to have variety. Very easy and intitive game to pick up and play a match of. I enjoy the dif clans. It;s also very lite on the system so it's a great game for a travel laptop.

Northguard a very fun game with a lot of reaplay ability and it runs very good on my not so good computer. I only get lagg spikes when it changes season. But the anoying thing is that it crashes so offten when you're loading into the game and it is so aggrowaiting. But the other negatives is that when you have played every clan you feel bored so I hope the 5:th clan will make me come back for more and the campaign mode also. But I still recommed it if you like RTS and it is hard because the map changes.

It's a decent game, but having to pay 4.99 a piece per clan for 3 extra clans is pretty absurd. I feel a little ripped off because when I first bought the game, I thought I was buying the whole game; I didn't realize future updates would try to charge me more. I wouldn't have purchased it had I known that, and certainly won't buy the extras now knowing that each new update is going to cost more.

Edit: I do not play the conquest because it isn't significantly different unless you co-op, but I paid for the game as a single-player game and co-op/multi player expansions don't add anything to what I paid for. I paid for the single player experience, and that is what you've decided to spontaneously charge more for. I don't care about playing online with people I don't even know, some of whom have an advantage by being able to pay for extras that I can't. People that buy SINGLE PLAYER games often want to play SINGLE PLAYER games. Imagine that!

Takes time to learn how to N0t die due to environmental things, let alone enemies. Quite fun once you grasp it. Matches are also quite fast for an RTS and for me that's great for a casual game.

The only con for me are victory conditions, Domination takes too much time and you'll probably win with fame before that. Commercial & Lore victories are lame. They should really do something to improve them

i'm working towards 2000 hours and while a lot of cool new stuff has been added, they've ruined other things. several clans aren't fun to play anymore, they're the same copy/paste mechanics as the starting clans. their highest difficulty bots have gone beyond being a challenge to contend with, they're now very obviously unrealistic and even normal difficulty bots have gotten harder to deal with, which i really don't understand why they would make this worse when so many negative reviews complained about AI being too hard to begin with. normal bots should not be attacking me before first winter with 10+ military, a war chief, and a completely functional village with nothing more than a woodcutter's lodge and a training camp

also idk what they did with this last patch but i've been crashing after almost every game

Just not a very good or fun game to me. Slow paced and boring. I had also kept getting attacked by the pc vikings at one of my nodes. You think ok just send troops to attack back. I couldn't send them because it was unexplored. I couldn't even explore it with a scout so there was no way to do anything about it. This tries to be original, but just isn't that fun. Just play age of empires instead it's better in many ways and you can actually send troops where you want.

An intriguing mix of Warcraft and Civilization, this RTS is unlike any I've ever played.

In the cold north where your vikings are settling, your enemies aren't the only things that can kill you : harsh winters, vicious wolves and the occasional mystical creature can all bring your clan to an end before ever meeting your opponents on the battlefield.

Multiplayer games typically last 40-60 minutes, a little longer than League of Legends matches, for example. Some polishing is still required, in PVP but the small team at Shiro is making frequent content and balance updates that continuously make the game better.

If I had one slight disappointment, it would be with the campaign. Though it is fun to play through, the story isn't developped enough, to my taste. Coming from games like Warcraft and Red Alert, I expected some stronger storytelling. It could also benefit from a bit more "teaching you how to play good".

Overall its a great and original game that's been a personal favorite in the past few months. Recommend !

Needs balance changes.

As of right now it is incredibly difficult to win in any situation. I've played on medium, and I've found that you cannot win this game unless you're going for a domination victory. If you focus on a Wisdom based victory, you will struggle to maintain food and wood stores, and you'll get your shit kicked in when mercernaries start showing up out of nowhere on your coastline (wtf even is that!?).

If you focus on anything other than complete and total military victory, all other clans will come and stomp you. And if you DO focus on military victory, you will fall far behind in fame, wisdom, and will be unable to keep up your food and wood stores. There are very few ways to produce a decent amount of food other than 'don't use your population'. If you happen to lose a significant chunk of population due to, again, OP mercs just showing the fuck up out of nowhere, you're screwed. Your population production relies heavily on already having a functioning population. There's no way to come back from a heavy attack, even if you successfully fend them off.

Far too many ways to lose, only one way to win. Needs balance changes and it'll be a great game.

Great single player game, should have never released a multiplayer if the following this were never going to be addressed:
- clans are imbalanced in 1v1 multiplayer
- no replay system
- no matchmaking system (I've paired with people that are 2 leagues above me)
- too much lag spikes in servers

It's the poor man's RTS and I mean it in the best way possible.

Your APM is too potato for SC2 or AoE? You want a "chill" RTS experience? Then this is the game for you.

Northgard combines AoE, Settlers and Civ gameplay in an awesome package and with the recently introduced Conquest mode (think randomly generated campaigns) has plenty of replayability.

The game focuses on the core mechanics of building and expanding your settlement while keeping the micromanagement to a minimum. Players can focus more on strategic decision-making rather than spending hours managing their resources and units. Overall, an excellent RTS game that offers a fun and less time-consuming experience compared to other titles in the genre.
Edit: Seems playable after few patches. But it is still laggy in multiplayer. I changed my review back to possitive.

Amazing, perfect vibe and gameplay. been playing for years will keep playing as long as they keep updating! i dont play multiplayer at all, story conquest and single player and definitely enough to keep you entertained!
Great game, but I would really like to be able to play a 5v3 against Hard AI with my friends (without the complexity of creating a custom map to achieve it).

it used to be good but then they fucked with the game mechanics and now they broke conquests so they don't even load and story mode? forget about it, the mechanics it relied on and wanted u to use cant be used anymore and its still the same story mode, fkin hilarious, these devs have no clue what they are doing

new update:
game has become really unresponsive taking a whole 5 seconds before doing anything after clicking
Multiplayer is just completely broken
It's a great game, however you have to buy additional add-ons to get better. It's BS. Fun, but greed made it cheap.

As of writing this I can say that, while this is most certainly a game that is under development and is missing a good chunk of features, the core gameplay is fun and entertaining. Even after hours of playing new map after new map against bots I find myself being challenged again per each restart. The dynamic maps that get generated along with a slew of victory conditions and acheivements can keep one fairly well entertained.

The downside is that since this is indeed an early access game and is being steadily worked on, it is missing things like multiplayer (planned to be added in) and other game changers. Still, it is a fun game and I'm excited to see where the devlopers take it in the future.

This is what Settlers 3 should have been.

I'am a developer myself, and strikes me back at my nostalgia from Settlers 2 and many hours spent on splitscreen with 2 mouses :)

Love it!
Northgard is fun, I think some of the DLC clans have very interesting play mechanics. But overall the game is solid and is just difficult enough to have you struggle for a good payoff victory.

A very fun game that can be whatever you want it to be! There always is something new and every game is different. Sometimes I play pretty laid back and enjoy the art and music. Sometimes I'm up for excitement and raid my way across the map. It's fun to play with a friend too!

I love this game, still a ways to go on its content but the look and feel of it is great. Totally worth the initial outlay of cash... The game casts me back to the days of Settlers IV, back when that series was fun. Remember choosing the Romans, the Myans or the Vikings, its got that great feel of a little village taking form, defending itself from enemies, but also the elements in this game. Give it a go, I dont think you'll regret it. I personally cant wait to see the game expand.

One thing i will say how is that i agree with some of the other reviews who have said it could do with a bit more character personalisation, currently your little villages do look like a clone village.. But thats just a small gripe, I think the game is great.
Very interesting RTS with creative mechanics I haven't found in other games of the genre. Very tactical.

11/10. Best RTS in a long time.

It can be challenging but you can also get a landslide victory if given the right starting area and surrounding sectors but I love the randomnly generated maps, keeps each game fresh and exciting.

Definitely needs more clans, more combat units, buildings and alot of work on small details but I can see this game is going to be amazing. It hasn't even got a campaign and I can't stop playing.

Can't wait to see more updates like the coming Crow clan next week, currently loving the Stags the most haha and I'm glad I took the risk and spent the $20, very worth it. Even as an EA game.

This game feels like a cross between a mobile game for a smartphone and a desktop game. It has a lot of the dynamics that make desktop RTS games great, but it isn't anywhere near as satisfying as a proper RTS like Age of Empires. Contrivances like using food to "purchase" new blocks of land to settle on feels too much like a mobile game and spending gold to "upgrade" existing blocks of land just so you can build more buildings on it makes no sense. I've requested a refund for this game.

Pros:
- FAST loading times on an SSD
- The story is decent
- Graphics are decent

Cons:
- Contrived game mechanics feel too much like a smartphone game

Genuinely an amazing take on an RTS. I typically hate RTS and how intensely based on APM/CPM/Constant full map vigilance, I think this game does such a damn good job of minimising that without making it feel too easy or too passive. It's a really hard task to distil RTS down into smaller scale combats and smaller scale worlds, but Northgard really achieves it in such a fun way.

Rat clan for the win, WORK YOU MASOCHISTS!

This game has a lot of potential, but I can't recommend purchasing this game at this phase in its development. The biggest problem right now is that most matches are determined by the randomly generated maps. You can tell if you are going to win or not in the first five minutes. If you start sandwiched between two enemies on one side of the island, each two tiles away, they will destroy you. Even if you survive, the fourth enemy is busy on the other side of the island getting that wisdom or trade win. Sometimes, there are no production tiles near you. Sometimes you are surrounded by two or three mob spawners. Sometimes, you have everything you need right away, making even “hard” an easy, boring win. The luck involved in random map generation negates any kind of nuance in strategy there might be in playing the different clans.

PRO:
• Game is fun, for those used to RTS games or not.
• Especially good with friends.

CONS:
• Poor UX when starting the game out, even in the tutorial phase, it is not well explained.
• Doesn't has many defensive strategies to counterattack unhealthy snowballing effects.

The AI in this game completely ruins it. AI opponents consistently target player in coordinated attacks from opposing sides of their territory, creating a 2 against 1 or 3 against 1 matchup that is unbeatable, especially when considering that the coordination and positioning means it is impossible to get your troops to the defending territory in time as they spend all their time running from A to B, and the second you make them run to A to defend against opponent 1, opponent 2 attacks you at territory B. Until they fix the opponent AI I do not recommend this game.

Do you like fun games? Games that work? Games that offer a good balance of challenge/reward?

Well this isn't that game. At worst you get a few minutes into the game, then the bots raid you twice or more at the same time so you're forced to start over. At best you do decent, The stats and military look good, but you get a ~3fps slide show you can't do anything about. It is a cool concept that can be fun at times and you can really get into it, but the current execution Is not there.

Enjoyable mechanics, challenging but not frustrating, lots of nice features beyond simply attacking and killing your foes particularly in Story Modes. I would consider this 80% Warcraft, 20% Civilization which for me is a nice balance since I enjoy both of those style of games quite a bit. When you don't feel like settling in for a day long Civilization game and don't feel like zoning out to an combat focused RTS, this is a nice alternative. I also appreciate the sound and graphics, it's just generally a well made game without the triple A expense and fanfare. Also, runs beautifully in Linux which is great. The only negative I would say is that probably none of your friends own the game and you're going to be playing primarily Linux steam users that found a new game to play where most people would rarely have stumbled on it in the regular store. For me, the story mode and single player experience was enough to have a great time.

Very interesting take on a RTS game. clan variations are great. though the city limitation is the hardest thing to wrap my head around. great coop game with replayability. the fact I can have 3 other friends join me on a conquest mode is icing on the cake.

tldr.text: Very Positive (84%): players praise the gameplay and combat, but recent reviews are noticeably less positive than the all-time score.
Bugs and crashes come up as a recurring complaint across reviews.

details.text: New players are far less positive, at 45% against 89% for players who have logged more time.
The latest update drew criticism, with 8% of reviews faulting developer updates and one saying "the AI cheats" so badly the game is unplayable; buyers should weigh that.
